name: zeptomail
description: Zoho ZeptoMail documentation. Transactional email service. Use for SMTP/API email sending, batch sending, templates (single/dynamic), domain addition & DNS verification (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), agents, webhooks, bounce/suppression handling, dedicated IP, reports, error/SMTP codes, transition & migration guides (SES/SendGrid/Mailgun/Mailchimp/Postmark/MailChannels/Mandrill), and integrations (WordPress/WooCommerce/Laravel/Django/Zapier/Make/n8n/Zoho Flow).

_source._reason: ZeptoMail help (www.zoho.com/zeptomail/help) is a JavaScript-rendered Zoho SPA with no public docs repo — pandoc html convert yields empty files. Crawled with Firecrawl (renders JS, returns markdown). Build/refresh: `firecrawl map https://www.zoho.com/zeptomail/help/` then `firecrawl crawl https://www.zoho.com/zeptomail/help/ --include-paths '/zeptomail/help/.*' --limit 150 --wait`; strip the leading nav sidebar (everything before the first H1) and the trailing '© <year> Zoho Corporation' footer; mirror sourceURL path under contents/ (keeps api/ and dns/ subdirs); drop query-param dupes, sitemap.xml, and the bare index.
